what: An eight-track groovebox you play live, for any style. Each track is a synth or a drum machine, with 223 presets on thirteen engines, 37 drum kits, a 64-step sequencer with locks, song sections, 27 punch-in effects, your own samples, MIDI and USB audio.
author: Josh McFarlin
